Gerard, your Magic M. 40T order is paid but hasn't shipped yet. I'm sorry for how this has gone. We gave dates and didn't keep them, and we should have kept you better informed.

The factory expects to send out the 40T units on November 12. Your Harlo OS diagnostics add-on ships in the same box. We'll email the tracking to (email hidden) as soon as your miner ships.

You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
